description:
ANGELINO was born from a spirit of California-style defiance—a mindset that refuses to be bound by existing values and instead pursues one’s own style.It embodies a culture shaped by resistance against racial discrimination and class divisions, a culture that champions freedom and individuality.

While made from the classic material of chromoly steel, it delivers a modern, responsive ride.Its ability to move freely, rebelliously, and beautifully through the streets reflects the original image of the fixed-gear culture we all once admired.

ANGELINO is a track bike for those who trust their own instincts and ride on their own terms.

ANGELINO is engineered to pursue the sensation of controlling the bike with your whole body in street environments.Its short wheelbase and tight rear center provide high maneuverability, allowing it to respond instantly to even the slightest shift in body weight.This agile handling pairs exceptionally well with street-specific moves like skidding and other dynamic actions.

At the same time, the frame offers a supple level of stiffness, making it comfortable to ride in a relaxed, flowing manner.It balances speed with ease, tension with release—letting you enjoy both extremes in one bike.

ANGELINO represents the ideal form of a fixed-gear bike that allows you to ride the streets in the most natural and most free way possible—a “fixed gear you ride with your whole body.”

The redesigned ANGELINO now features an expanded tire clearance of up to 35c, broadening its territory.It offers the versatility to ride seamlessly across both on-road and off-road surfaces with confident performance.

This new model also introduces internal brake routing, allowing brakes to be installed without interrupting ANGELINO’s clean, powerful silhouette.

You can build this track bike with any custom setup you prefer.Please feel free to contact us anytime.
